_comment: One redistribution decision per managed tool id. build-full-pack.py refuses a tool in the registry that has no entry here. 'source' and 'obligations' are copied into the pack's THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-FULL-PACK.md. Reviewed against the licence the registry names; not legal advice.

capa.obligations: Apache-2.0: keep the LICENSE and NOTICE files. The release is a PyInstaller executable that embeds Python libraries under their own licences; the build does not list them, so the unlisted notices are a residual gap.

floss.obligations: Apache-2.0: keep the LICENSE and NOTICE files. Also a PyInstaller executable with embedded libraries (same residual gap as capa).

upx.obligations: GPL-2.0-or-later with the UPX stub exception: ship the COPYING and LICENSE files (they arrive with the download) and make the source available.

die.source: Source: https://github.com/horsicq/DIE-engine (tag 3.21); Qt: https://download.qt.io/; ICU 66 source: https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/i/icu/.
die.obligations: MIT (DIE); the portable build ships Qt under LGPL-3.0 as shared libraries (keep them replaceable and the LGPL text); Ubuntu's ICU 66 under the Unicode licence (its copyright file is in licenses/die/).

ghidra.source: Ghidra: https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra (tag Ghidra_12.1.4_build). Temurin JDK: https://github.com/adoptium/jdk21u (tag jdk-21.0.12+1).
ghidra.obligations: Ghidra is Apache-2.0 (keep LICENSE and NOTICE, and the licenses folder it ships). The Eclipse Temurin 21 JDK is GPL-2.0 with the Classpath Exception: keep its legal notices and make its source available.

volatility3.source: Source: https://github.com/volatilityfoundation/volatility3 (tag v2.28.2); pefile, Capstone and PyCryptodome wheels from PyPI.
volatility3.obligations: Volatility Software License 1.0 is not an OSI licence: it requires the licence text to accompany every copy (licenses/volatility3/VSL-1.0.txt) and applies copyleft to 'Additions', including wrappers written to execute the software and parse its results. The unmodified wheel may be redistributed with the text. Maintainer review recommended before publishing.

memnixfs.source: Source: https://github.com/MemNixFS/MemNixFS (tag v1.2); libfmt9 and libfuse3 sources in https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/f/fmtlib/ and /fuse3/.
memnixfs.obligations: Apache-2.0 (keep LICENSE and NOTICE); libfmt MIT; libfuse3 LGPL-2.1-or-later, shipped as a replaceable shared library with its Debian copyright file in licenses/memnixfs/.

sigma.source: pySigma https://github.com/SigmaHQ/pySigma; SQLite backend https://github.com/SigmaHQ/pySigma-backend-sqlite; other wheels from PyPI.
sigma.obligations: pySigma is LGPL-3.0 and its backend LGPL-2.1: the wheels are unmodified pure-Python packages that users can replace. Each wheel keeps the licence files in its dist-info folder.

magika.obligations: Apache-2.0. The release asset holds only the executable, so the licence text is supplied in licenses/magika/.

gef.obligations: MIT (bata24; derived from GEF by hugsy). The licence text is supplied in licenses/gef/.

pwndbg.source: pwndbg: https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg (tag 2026.09.15). GDB 17.2: https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gdb/. Python and the other bundled libraries: see the licence files inside the portable build.
pwndbg.obligations: pwndbg is MIT, but the portable build bundles GDB 17.2 (GPL-3.0-or-later) with Python (PSF) and other libraries: redistributing it makes the pack a distribution of GDB, so GPL-3.0 source availability applies. Whoever passes a pack on must make GDB's source available.

wireproxy.obligations: ISC (licence text supplied in licenses/wireproxy/). The static Go binary also embeds wireguard-go (MIT) and other Go modules whose notices the release does not list.

tor.obligations: Tor is BSD-3-Clause (this build also states GPL-3.0-or-later); libevent BSD-3-Clause, OpenSSL Apache-2.0, and the lyrebird and conjure transports under their own licences. The bundle's docs/ folder holds the licence texts and is kept. The bundle is redistributed unmodified; do not alter it and still call it Tor.
